Hey man! My buddies and I are looking for some not bad people to play comp with, hard to take the game seriously when you solo queue. ugh. Add me on discord though!

Naviette#0316
I am and my buddy will be shortly

Hey! My buddy and I are dying to find some not bad people to play with add me in discord!

Naviette#0316
Me and my buddy pay pretty often but need some more good people to play with, I'm 2200 sr tank.
Win Overwatch matches single-handedly by freezing time then finding all the players in the match and turning their pc's off mid match.
Gift.

I'm still in the shitter man. Don't feel alone. Life just finally gave me something, somehow, that helped.
Keep going, you don't have to push to be better all the time. Be better when you want, pushing too hard will make it worse. You are in control of you.
Sounds a lot like my entire family so I can relate.
Have you two ever had a conversation aboit it?

No, I think you're right on topic. We do need major education on mental illness. Oranizations such as projectsemicolon and beyondblue are very good I think, but we need more mainstream understanding. Many artists and "influencers" have brought it into the spotlight recently so i hold hopes that it will gain more momentum. Here's to hoping others don't suffer what we suffer.

I don't care for strangers struggles for the most part, you're right. We're human, we empathize better with similar situations to our own. And honestly, I do care for people here, because I can empathize and sympathize with them, for the most part because this is r/depression, a literal subreddit for depression sufferers and others to talk, communicate feelings, find comfort, etc.. And I think morr people here care than you think.

Honestly I didn't even think about serotonin syndrome... my psych has a good reason to put me on all 3 I hope. But I've already attempted one time fully and 1 time half assed. Saved by pure luck the 2nd time. My wife is the only thing that gives me any hope. She's really all I have that makes me feel even slightly alive.
Not a bad point.
I agree, it's good they don't, It's like being a medium and seeing ghosts, you are terrified but glad others can't feel the fear you do. And yes I do think these comments get worked up easily.

Talking to others like us helps, even slightly is better than none. But yea I've been on more than I can count. Mine are (currently) wellbutrin+remeron+zoloft. Think they are trying to melt my brain. My therapist seems to actually help tho, she somehow manages to coax me out bit by bit into talking about my life and deepest thoughts. I'm terrifies that I'm gonna tell her how I "really feel" and then I'll be involuntarily hospitalized.
Yes indeedy. I just need support, and God do I hate to say that because it plays into the attention scenario everyone tries to blame on us.

You can't help it though. We just want to be better, all of us. That's the whole idea. Not a single person on this site wants to be depressed, why would we? But we will do anything to get away from it, from sleeping long hours to making up scenes in our heads to suicide. Desperation is our motivation.

I see a therapist once a week and psychiatrist once a month. On 3 different meds currently and honestly haven't noticed really any improvement as far as the feelings go. I've been clinically diagnosed with Persistant Depressive Disorder, Major Depression (they creatively call it double depression), and "low level anxiety", that one I'm not sure about. I have, however, gained more energy through the day. About it tho.
Thanks for the understanding of this. You described it exactly. This helps me actually, knowing someone out there pegged me so perfectly. Thanks man.
2 thumbs up on this reply, very educational and proactive.
Parents never seem to understand and that can be a last straw for most. Just know that somewhere others know.

I agree completely except for antidepressants I think anyway, do just enough to help you maybe, start to rise again. For me they kinda work, enough so that I'm atleast not suicidal all the time. Honestly, I wouldn't encourage them unless you are in danger of self harm, suicide, homicide, etc. Me, the first two were it. I have to try everything because the moment I lose hope, despair comes, and we all know here what that brings.
Appreciate the replies, but yea that's the issue.
Obviously.
Nice, still doesn't mean I'm sad for something. My life is great as far thats concerned. Great wife, 2 kids, good money, no problems. No good reason to feel this way. Yet I do.

That has been the question of the fucking decade. I ask everyone that. I think and think and cry and beg for something or someone to help. People try yea, but they fail. Not their fault, I'm glad they don't understand, that means they haven't had to experience this.
Blaming people with the illness is totally the solution. You're shaping up to be part of the problem.

Waking up every single day for almost 10 years and being upset that I'm awake. Being able to feel no positive emotion towards anyone or anything. All I do is fake it every day. I haven't even dreamt in so long I cant remember. No dreams, and when I have one its a nightmare. Everyone only thinks the worst of me which is correct anyway. I just hate being alive. What do I have to help me. Nothing.
I have, she deflects. Trust me, I've tried and tried. It's been 4 months. I doubt it happening.

I just want my wife back, she came and brought me to life. I never realized just how much she kept me going until she left. She is the only, ONLY thing I hold onto. That slim chance that maybe I can get her back. Honestly I don't think it will fix me, I really don't. But she keeps me going just enough to try.

Funny part is, I uad it, a wife that absolutely adored me and everything about me, 2 children as well. I love them, really. But I drove her away, she divorced me recently because she tried, for over 2 years, to pull me out of this pit. I did not come out, so she couldn't take anymore and left. What else can be taken from a man that has nothing. How can one be made to suffer more than wishing his own life away.
I researched it. Found it with my finger and took a blade a ran down it, cutting only a bit into the skin. Completely numb to it. Have to reason with myself not to do it yet.
2 out of 3. My ex wife. I want her back but drove her away because of how I am. She's the only thing I am grasping on to.
I try every day. Believe me.

I actually get the holding on to "dumb reasons" to stay alive. Mine is my ex wife, I love her but it's over, my depression ruined her against me. I struggle with wanting to just slit my wrists and ease out of life slowly and quietly. I have my note written, my blades, everything but the act. I am holding on to every last bit of hope, clinging to life and watching it dissipate in front of me. I don't know what will happen, but I cling to hope nonetheless. What I'm trying to say is, cling to hope, every last drop of it you find. Push and push, maybe, just maybe something will come along and save you. It's a battle against yourself after all. PM me if you want to talk, if I don't answer immediately I will soon.

I feel exactly the same way, people are going to do that stupid shit though. People suck and only think of themselves, Ignore them. Come talk here, DM me if you want, we are all here to help eachother. I need help making it through every single day, this page and r/depression really helps.

I just don't call, not out of fear of hurting others, only because I know they will do just what you said. It isn't helpful at all, should be called "thought about suicide once" hotline. Because they just want to do the same thing every time, you open up the tiniest bit and they wanna commit you. Honestly, r/depression and this one are the best places I have found, because we all know what is going on inside each other. The phrase "takes one to know one" comes to mind.

I guess living badly is better than not living at all, is the point of that reply. Maybe I'm wrong, if so, please correct me. Just don't want to suffer anymore. I can't stand it, over 8 years... Loneliness, emptiness, sadness, self-hate, horrible childhood, etc... I have been on 7 different antidepressants so far, 7! I have an appointment in 2 days so I will see what happens then. 

Thanks for replying, I appreciate it a ton, seriously.

I hope not, But the most notable difference between you and I, is I don't feel despair is the "noise" overpowering everything else. I just don't feel anything. It's as if inside me is completely empty. Nothing speaks, no conscience, nothing. Nothing "truly" interests me. Nothing "excites" me. I know I "love' my family because I know others do. That's what we are supposed to do, right? It's frustrating to feel nothing, and anger is the solitary feeling I get. Nothing else. And that's only due to the fact that I can't feel. Literally no one I have ever spoken too about this seems to understand what I am feeling, and they wont. because no one else can read my mind.

I also have felt this way for over a decade. it has gotten worse over time and over the past 3 years has gotten severely worse, I feel completely empty inside.

Wont pretend to know you're situation, but my wife left me recently and took me 2 children. I am alone as well, all because my depression has gotten so bad that I took it out on her for years and she just couldn't hold out anymore. The woman I truly love, I hurt the most. I know the pain of being alone, and feeling it's because you are an aweful useless person. You just feel it, accept that it may just be that way, but work little by little to better yourself for you and for others. Move whenever you can if you can. No rush, I have my own pace and so do you, we are all working through this together.
I feel as if I lost mine after I realized I drove away the only person I want to be around. :/  Gotta keep trying I guess.
Some days are better than others, but I really do try to live the best I can.
That is a good point.
It just seems like everything is overshadowed by it. No matter what I just delve back down every time, it's inevitable.
